subject: Intro chat scheduling — Product Manager (time zone grid & quick prep)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amara Johnson <amara.johnson+applicant@gmail.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jan 2028 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Intro chat scheduling — Product Manager (time zone grid & quick prep)

Hi Amara,

Thanks again for applying to the Product Manager role and for the thoughtful note on your background — really liked the bit about launching cross-functional ML features. I'd love to set up a 30-minute introductory call to learn more about your experience and walk through the role.

Below are a few slots that work on our side (all 30 minutes). I converted them to a few common time zones so it's easier to scan — if none of these work, send me 2–3 windows that do and I'll follow up.

Option A: Mon Jan 15 — 9:30–10:00 PT / 12:30–13:00 ET / 17:30–18:00 GMT+2
Option B: Mon Jan 15 — 13:00–13:30 PT / 16:00–16:30 ET / 21:00–21:30 GMT+11
Option C: Tue Jan 16 — 8:00–8:30 PT / 11:00–11:30 ET / 04:00–04:30 GMT+13 (we know this is early for some time zones)

A couple quick notes:
- This will be a short screen with me + the hiring manager (Markus Klein) — we cover background, current work, and 2–3 product scenarios.
- Please attach the latest copy of your resume if you haven’t already (I attached the version we have for reference).
- Expect a Google Meet link in the confirmation if we lock a slot.

Attached: resume_AmaraJohnson.pdf (from application)

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Recruiter, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
